summary: In the evidence, 'world model' first appears in AI planning and robotics in the 1980s as the system's internal representation of its surroundings; from 1991 work on curious neural controllers and Dyna made it an adaptive model learned from experience for planning. Today it mostly means a large learned predictive or generative model (often video-based) of how an environment changes in response to actions, used by robots, self-driving systems and LLM agents to imagine outcomes and plan.
